title: BMU menen Xinjiang Universityinin ortosunda kyzmattashtykty keneytuu boyuncha zholugushuu otttu

blocks.text: Bugun BMUnun to the rector, Professor Mirlan Dyldaev Kytai El Republicsynyn Xinjiang University Geography zhana distancek meykindikte izildoөө ilimder institutenunun to the director, Professor Zhang Feng zhetektegen delegations kabyl aldy. Delegation of Kuramynda Academylyk Ishter Boyuncha Vice-Rector, Associate Professor Ma Xu, Professor Xu Changchun Zhana Okutuuchu Dai Yue Boldu. Zholugushuuga BMU taraptan El aralyk baylanyshtar bolumun director Edil Kanatbekov, coordinator Rakhat Rai kyzy, Geography, tourism zhana tabigyi imder departmentsyn bashchysy Alymkul Orozaliev zhana Ecology zhana zharatylyshty paidalanuu departmentsyn bashchysy Ainura Moldobachaeva katyshty.

Zholugushuuda eki universitytin geography, ecology zhana alystan zondoo tarmaktaryndagy kyzmattashtygy tuuraluu talkuu zhurup, okutuuchu zhana studentterdin academylyk mobileduulugun onunukturuү, birgeleshken ilimiy Isildөөlөrdү zүrgүzүү, seminar-trainingderdi өtkөrүү mүmkүnchүlүktөrү karaldy. Taraptar bilim beruzhana ilim tarmagyndagy oz ara baylanyshtardy chyndogo kyzykdar ekenin bildiristi.
